_note: PicklistSchema (`data/picklist.zod.ts`) — a shared option list that select fields reference by name (`Field.select({ picklist })`). Read at runtime by the ObjectQL registry, which merges `picklistExtensions` into the list (additive only) and resolves it onto every field that names it. The ADR-0010 envelope keys carry the same `null` verdict as `capability`: loader-stamped, not authored.

name.note: The handle a field's `picklist` names: the registry looks the list up by it when it resolves a field, and the boot audit refuses a field whose name matches no registered list.

label.note: display: the list's own label, served with the kind (`GET /meta/picklist`; the artifact door registers `picklists:` as items) and translated under `picklists.<name>.label` (`translatePicklist`). A Studio picklist page is a later phase.

description.note: display: served with the kind (`GET /meta/picklist`) for authors choosing a list.

options.note: Merged with every `picklistExtensions` entry's options (additive only — a repeated value is refused, `registerPicklistExtension`) and written onto each referencing field's served `options`, which the record validator judges writes against.

label.note: Reaches every consumer as the referencing field's resolved option label, translated under `picklists.<name>.options.<value>` (`translateObject`).

value.note: The value a write to a referencing field is judged against, through the field's resolved `options`.

description.note: Carried onto the referencing field's resolved option, where the same key is `live` on `field.json`.

color.note: display: carried onto the referencing field's resolved option, rendered like an inline option's (`field.options`).

default.note: Carried onto the referencing field's resolved option, so the engine's insert-time option default and the import template's required star read it like an inline option's (`packages/rest/src/import-template-route.test.ts`).

visibleWhen.note: Carried onto the referencing field's resolved option, where the option-visibility predicate reads it like an inline option's.
